scope: Batch 09: twelve previously unreviewed missing original qualifying-club websites, Bishop Auckland through Bourne Town. All 80 current clubs already verified and linked. Website identity only; no correspondence, location, competition or search-origin changes.

Research-reader timeouts cleared through an ordinary HTTP GET, which returned 200; no access restriction bypassed.

Southern League's current preview corroborates its 3-1 Real Bedford result. Homepage returned 200 on ordinary HTTP check after reader timeouts.
